heavy_rain.title: 🌧️ Heavy rain
heavy_rain.message: Heavy rain recorded (24 h: {rain_24h}). Dry-down timers updated.

stale_lock.title: ⚠️ Irrigation lock reset
stale_lock.message: The irrigation lock was stuck on for more than 3 hours. It was reset so future runs aren't blocked.

valve_watchdog.title: 🚨 Valve watchdog fired
valve_watchdog.message: The valve stayed on for {minutes} minutes in a row. It was switched off to protect the plants.

power_loss.title: 🚨 Power loss during watering
power_loss.message: The valve or pump lost power for 10+ minutes mid-cycle. Watering stopped and the lock was cleared; the next scheduled run will try again.

power_restore_anomaly.title: 🚨 Valve on after power restore
power_restore_anomaly.message: The valve reported on after power came back — it was forced off. Check the relay and wiring.

restart_lock_cleared.title: 🚨 Watering interrupted by a restart
restart_lock_cleared.message: Home Assistant restarted mid-cycle. The lock was cleared and the valve forced off if reachable; the next scheduled run will try again.

deficit_ended.title: 🌶️ Deficit mode ended
deficit_ended.message: Its end date has passed — routine watering is back to the full dose.

no_flow.title: ⚠️ {cycle}: no water flow
no_flow.message: The cycle finished but the flow meter shows no water delivered. Check the valve, pump and flow-meter wiring.

cycle_error_closed.title: ⚠️ {cycle}: stopped by an error
cycle_error_closed.message: Stopped: {error}. The valve is closed; the next scheduled run will try again.

cycle_error_open.title: ⚠️ {cycle}: stopped by an error
cycle_error_open.message: Stopped: {error}. {valve} may still be OPEN — check it now.

low_pump_power.title: ⚠️ {cycle}: low pump power
low_pump_power.message: Pulse {pulse} is running but the pump reads {watts} W.

stopped_by_rain.title: 🌧️ {cycle} stopped by rain
stopped_by_rain.message: Stopped after {given} of {planned} min: {rain} fell in the last 30 minutes. The next scheduled run decides again, taking this rain into account.

forecast_override.title: ⏱️ Watering despite the forecast
forecast_override.message: Rain kept being forecast but none has fallen in {days} days (this zone's limit is {limit} days) — watering anyway.

deep_soak_cap.title: ⚠️ Deep soak not run: runtime cap
deep_soak_cap.message: The calculated runtime ({minutes} min) is over this zone's deep soak safety cap. Watering cancelled — check the flow rate and target depth.

routine_cap.title: ⚠️ Routine watering not run: runtime cap
routine_cap.message: The calculated runtime ({minutes} min) is over this zone's routine safety cap ({cap} min). Watering cancelled — check the flow rate and weekly targets.

daily_cap.title: ⚠️ {cycle} skipped: daily runtime cap
daily_cap.message: Already {used} min today; this run ({minutes} min) would go over the {cap} min daily cap. It will try again when due.

rain_cancel.title: 🌧️ {cycle} cancelled
rain_cancel.message: Cancelled: {rain} fell in the last 30 minutes.

deep_soak_done.title: 🚿 Deep soak completed
deep_soak_done.message: {amount} applied over {pulses} pulse(s) ({minutes} min). Counts as routine watering too.{next}

overdue.title: ⚠️ Watering overdue
overdue.message: {days} days since the last watering — an unusually long gap, worth checking the system.

probe_check.title: 🌱 Check the soil probe
probe_check.message: Wet soil readings ({pct}%) have held routine watering back for {days} days. If it hasn't rained much, check the probe (placement, battery, reading) — it's still being followed.

probe_frozen.title: 🌱 Soil probe looks frozen
probe_frozen.message: The soil probe has read wet ({pct}%) for {days} days without a new report in 24 h, so watering follows the schedule again. Check the probe (battery, connection).

service_auto_off.title: 🔧 Service Mode switched off
service_auto_off.message: Service Mode ran for {minutes} min and switched itself off (the auto-off time).

service_auto_off_capped.title: 🔧 Service Mode switched off
service_auto_off_capped.message: Service Mode ran for {minutes} min and switched itself off (shortened to fit today's runtime safety cap).

self_tune_shorter.title: 🌱 Self-tuning adjustment
self_tune_shorter.message: Routine dry-down holdoff shortened to {days} days, based on your recent early runs.

self_tune_longer.title: 🌱 Self-tuning adjustment
self_tune_longer.message: Routine dry-down holdoff extended to {days} days, based on your recent snoozes.

frost.title: ❄️ {cycle} waiting: frost
frost.message: It's {temp}, below the frost guard of {limit}. It checks again every hour for up to {hours} hours, then waits for its next scheduled time.

flow_measured.title: 💧 Flow rate measured
flow_measured.message: {volume} in {minutes} min: the emitter flow rate is now {rate}.

flow_measure_failed.title: ⚠️ Flow rate not measured
flow_measure_failed.message: The flow meter counted {volume} in {minutes} min, which doesn't give a usable flow rate. Check the meter and the area, or work it out from the emitters instead (Configure → Flow rate).

fertilize_due.title: 🌱 {zone}: time to fertilize
fertilize_due.message: Due {date}. Press Fertilized Today when it's done; the next date is worked out from there.

greenhouse_failsafe.title: ⚠️ {zone}: climate sensor failsafe
greenhouse_failsafe.message: No inside temperature sensor is working. Misters are off; vents and fans: {mode}; heater: {heater}.

greenhouse_recovered.title: ✅ {zone}: climate control back to normal
greenhouse_recovered.message: The inside temperature sensor is reporting again.

greenhouse_device.title: ⚠️ {zone}: {device} not responding
greenhouse_device.message: {entity} did not switch as commanded, even after a second try.

greenhouse_mist_stuck.title: ⚠️ {zone}: mister was stuck on
greenhouse_mist_stuck.message: A mister stayed on past its pulse and was switched off.

greenhouse_mist_halted.title: 🚨 {zone}: misting stopped
greenhouse_mist_halted.message: A mister would not switch off, so misting is stopped. Check it, then press Reset Irrigation Lock.

greenhouse_backup_sensor.title: ⚠️ {zone}: using the backup temperature sensor
greenhouse_backup_sensor.message: The main inside temperature sensor ({entity}) stopped working. Climate control carries on with the backup.

notes.soil_dry_forced: Soil moisture {pct}% (dry) — watered before the schedule was due.
notes.deficit_hot: Deficit mode: full dose today (hot weather).
notes.deficit_soil_dry: Deficit mode: full dose today (soil at the dry threshold).
notes.deficit_no_temp: Deficit mode: full dose (no temperature reading on record).
notes.deficit_young: Deficit mode: full dose (plant still on its growth ramp).

status.lock_held: On hold: an earlier run didn't finish (the zone is locked)
status.skipped_soil_wet: {cycle} skipped at {time}: the soil is wet ({pct}%)
status.skipped_drydown: {cycle} skipped at {time}: drying out after rain until {until}
status.skipped_rain_credit: {cycle} skipped at {time}: recent rain ({rain}) covers the {target} needed
status.skipped_wet_fortnight: {cycle} held at {time}: {rain} of rain in the last 14 days
status.skipped_service: {cycle} skipped at {time}: a service run was using the valve
status.cancelled_rain: {cycle} cancelled at {time}: it was raining ({rain} in 30 min)
status.refused_runtime_cap: {cycle} not run at {time}: {minutes} min needed, over the {cap} min cycle cap
status.refused_deep_soak_cap: {cycle} not run at {time}: {minutes} min needed, over its cap
status.refused_daily_cap: {cycle} not run at {time}: it would pass today's {cap} min safety cap
status.waiting_soil_wet: Waiting for the soil to dry ({pct}%)
status.paused: Paused: no watering until Pause is switched off
status.skipped_frost: {cycle} skipped at {time}: {temp}, below the frost guard ({limit})
status.waiting_frost: {cycle} on hold at {time}: {temp}, below the frost guard ({limit}); checking again hourly
status.waiting_deep_soak: {cycle} waiting since {time}: the deep soak goes first once it's warm enough
status.paused_area: Paused: no watering while {area} is paused

status.failsafe: Failsafe: no inside temperature (vents and fans: {mode}; heater: {heater})
status.mist_halted: Misting stopped: press Reset Irrigation Lock
status.gate_blocked: Not ventilating: outside air ({outside}) is not cooler than inside ({temp})
status.held_until_resume: {device} switched by hand: automatic again when you press Resume Automatic

heater_mode.outside: on part of the time while cold outside

override.rain_counter_entity: Uses its own rain gauge, not {area}'s.
override.outdoor_temp_entity: Uses its own outdoor temperature sensor, not {area}'s.
override.weather_entity: Uses its own weather entity, not {area}'s.
override.notify_entity: Sends to its own phone, not {area}'s.
